description: Create a new geo-targeted proxy list on a shared proxy. Provide either a single country (with optional region/city/isp/zip subfilters) or a countries array (2-30, mutually exclusive with the subfilters). To edit an existing list, delete it and create a new one.

city.description: Only valid with a single country.

countries.description: 2-30 ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Mutually exclusive with country/subfilters.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2, lowercased. Mutually exclusive with countries.

format.description: Output format for entries[] (e.g. login_pass_host_port, http_url, socks5_url)

isp.description: Only valid with a single country.

region.description: Only valid with a single country.

zip.description: Only valid with a single country.

name: create_proxy_list
